segments.he: בְּהַעֲבָרָהבְּעָלְמָא רָאִיתִי בִּכְתָבָיו מִי שֶׁאֵין לוֹ גְּבוּרַת-אֲנָשִׁים  יאמַר  שִׁיר-הַשִּׁירִים  מִשְׁלֵי קהֶלֶת, כִּי הֵם בְּחִינַת תְּלָת טִפִּין כַּמּוּבָא בַּתִּקּוּנִים [תִּקּוּן י"ג כ"ט:] עַיֵּן שָׁם.
segments.en: (20.) Regarding the known controversy that existed in previous generations about the Rabbi, the Gaon our teacher the Rabbi Yonasan of blessed memory — and there was before Rabbainu o.b.m. the book in which the amulets that the aforementioned Rabbi gave were written. And it was written in them: "His servant MVY"CH." And those who opposed him interpreted this as: "His servant his Messiah" — see there. And Rabbainu o.b.m. told us about this and said there is no proof from this. And he said: if he were to write amulets and they were found, they would certainly say... — particularly "his servant" (meaning...).
